content.body: The Panzer II C was the natural evolution of the Wehrmacht early training tanks, up-gunned with a 20 mm automatic cannon in place of the light machinegun Panzer I from the interwar years. Due to production delays and teething problems with the early Panzer III's and IV's, the Panzer II C ended up being deployed in unexpected numbers. It was in fact used as a main battle tank in Poland, where more than 90% of the tanks used were Panzer I's II's.
